1 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.RetainedCutConnectivity
2 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronRetainedCutSegments
3 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronRetainedRadialPaths
4 import SixVertexUnfolding.Geometry.SmallPolyhedronCutTreeCharts
5 
6 /-! The cut tree with original leaves removed joins every remaining
7 cut point. Together with the retained radial paths, it joins every
8 pair of points of the actual uncut surface.
9 This version uses the broader small-polyhedron route results. Where
10 nonoverlap is needed, it is stated explicitly as separation of the charts. -/
11 
12 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
13 
14 open Set
15 
16 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (size : P.vertices.card ≤ 6)
17   (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
18     (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4)
19 
20 include size small_faces
21 
22 /-- An interior edge point can join a retained endpoint without reaching an original leaf. -/
23 theorem small_retained_cut_point_joins_vertex {a : frontier P.body} (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
24     (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
25     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val)
26     (b : frontier P.body) (cut : b ∈ P.cutSet a) (nonvertex : (b : Space) ∉ P.vertices) :
27     ∃ u : T.vertices, (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices ∧
28       JoinedIn (P.starCuts a)ᶜ b (T.vertexTarget u) := by
29   have trace : (b : Space) ∈ P.cutSetInSpace a := ⟨b, cut, rfl⟩
30   rcases (T.trace b).mp trace with vertex | ⟨u, v, edge, inside⟩
31   · exact ⟨⟨b, vertex⟩, nonvertex,
32       JoinedIn.refl (small_nonvertex_cutPoint_uncut size small_faces a b cofacial cut nonvertex)⟩
33   · have segment_member := openSegment_subset_segment ℝ (u : Space) (v : Space) inside
34     have segment_cut := T.toEmbeddedCutGraph.closed_edge_in_trace edge
35     rcases T.edge_has_nonvertex_endpoint charts edge with first | last
36     · exact ⟨u, first, small_retained_cut_segment_joined size small_faces a b (T.vertexTarget u)
37         cofacial nonvertex first
38         (((convex_segment (u : Space) (v : Space)).segment_subset segment_member
39           (left_mem_segment ℝ _ _)).trans segment_cut)⟩
40     · exact ⟨v, last, small_retained_cut_segment_joined size small_faces a b (T.vertexTarget v)
41         cofacial nonvertex last
42         (((convex_segment (u : Space) (v : Space)).segment_subset segment_member
43           (right_mem_segment ℝ _ _)).trans segment_cut)⟩
44 
45 /-- Every two nonvertex cut points can be joined without crossing a star cut. -/
46 theorem small_retained_cut_points_joined {a : frontier P.body} (T : P.CutLocusTree a)
47     (charts : CutTreeCharts T)
48     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val)
49     (b c : frontier P.body) (b_cut : b ∈ P.cutSet a) (c_cut : c ∈ P.cutSet a)
50     (b_nonvertex : (b : Space) ∉ P.vertices) (c_nonvertex : (c : Space) ∉ P.vertices) :
51     JoinedIn (P.starCuts a)ᶜ b c := by
52   obtain ⟨u, un, to_u⟩ := small_retained_cut_point_joins_vertex size small_faces T charts cofacial b b_cut b_nonvertex
53   obtain ⟨v, vn, to_v⟩ := small_retained_cut_point_joins_vertex size small_faces T charts cofacial c c_cut c_nonvertex
54   exact (to_u.trans (small_retained_cut_vertices_joined size small_faces T charts cofacial u v un vn)).trans to_v.symm
55 
56 /-- The actual polyhedral boundary minus the cofacial-source star cuts is path connected. -/
57 theorem small_cofacial_uncut_surface_pathConnected (a : frontier P.body)
58     (cofacial : ∀ v : P.Vertex, ∃ F : P.Face, (a : Space) ∈ F.val ∧ (v : Space) ∈ F.val) :
59     IsPathConnected (P.starCuts a)ᶜ := by
60   classical
61   obtain ⟨T⟩ := small_exists_regular_cut_tree size small_faces a
62   obtain ⟨charts⟩ := small_exists_cut_tree_charts size small_faces a T cofacial
63   have nonvertex_exists : ∃ u : T.vertices, (u : Space) ∉ P.vertices := by
64     obtain ⟨u⟩ := T.tree.connected.nonempty
65     by_cases original : (u : Space) ∈ P.vertices
66     · obtain ⟨v, edge, _⟩ := charts.original_leaves u original
67       exact ⟨v, (T.edge_has_nonvertex_endpoint charts edge).resolve_left (not_not.mpr original)⟩
68     · exact ⟨u, original⟩
69   obtain ⟨u, nonvertex⟩ := nonvertex_exists
70   apply isPathConnected_iff.mpr
71   refine ⟨⟨T.vertexTarget u, small_nonvertex_cutPoint_uncut size small_faces a _ cofacial
72     (T.vertexTarget_cut u) nonvertex⟩, ?_⟩
73   intro b b_uncut c c_uncut
74   obtain ⟨d, dcut, dn, to_d⟩ := small_retained_point_joins_cut_locus size small_faces a cofacial ⟨b, b_uncut⟩
75   obtain ⟨e, ecut, en, to_e⟩ := small_retained_point_joins_cut_locus size small_faces a cofacial ⟨c, c_uncut⟩
76   exact (to_d.trans (small_retained_cut_points_joined size small_faces T charts cofacial d e dcut ecut dn en)).trans to_e.symm
77 
78 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron
